20261122-chemistry-h3-2.topic: Wen car crash happen, solid sodium
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.goal: Apply principles of Wen car crash happen, solid sodium to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.material: Wen car crash happen, solid sodium azide (NaN₃) dey break down to inflate di airbag inside 0.03 second, and di chemical equation na 2NaN₃(s) → 2Na(s) + 3N₂(g). Wetin be di most ideal chemical reason why dis reaction good for making airbag gas?
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.thinking.0: Wen car crash happen, solid sodium
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.prompt: Wen car crash happen, solid sodium azide (NaN₃) dey break down to inflate di airbag inside 0.03 second, and di chemical equation na 2NaN₃(s) → 2Na(s) + 3N₂(g). Wetin be di most ideal chemical reason why dis reaction good for making airbag gas?
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.explain: Sodium azide dey break down in a flash wen electric spark hit am, and e dey produce plenty nitrogen gas ($\text{N}_2$) wey no dey harm human body and e dey chemically inert, so e dey protect di passengers wey crash safely.
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.hint.0: Nitrogen gas (N₂) make up 78% of air, e no dey harm human body and e no dey burn.
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.hint.1: 2 mol of solid suddenly expand to 3 mol of gas.
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.o.o0: Because small solid dey react to produce plenty very safe and stable inert nitrogen (N₂) gas at explosive speed
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.o.o1: Because e dey produce poisonous chlorine gas to clean di air
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.o.o2: Because e dey cool down to minus 50 degrees during di reaction
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.o.o3: Because no gas dey form and e just dey swell like solid sponge
